name: Multiple maps: game-side loader for edited layouts
summary: The HQ map editor edits layout definitions — the same WorldLayout-shaped input the seeded generator already consumes (the Zoo proves a second layout works). What's missing is the game-side half: loading an edited layout JSON into a real game. This project is that bridge, and it deliberately waits on a few design calls.
requirements: A validated loader (layout JSON -> WorldLayout dictionary) with sim-level tests: bad rects, overlapping parcels, missing gates all refused with reasons
Station positions (cot, bin, well, seed box, pen) move from sim code constants into the layout, so maps can place them
A ruled answer on how multiple maps relate: alternate farms? connected areas? phase-2 spaces? (designer call — shapes the save format)
Save/replay integrity: a session records which map it was generated from, so replays and the build-stamp discipline survive multiple maps
Determinism proof extended: same seed + same layout = identical world, per map
current_status: Moving. The maps ruling landed 2026-09-06 as S-11 (door-linked pages of one world) and the first transition is live: the farmhouse door on the farm leads into the T-37 home, now page 1 of a 32x40 grid, with the bed indoors and a doorway back. Transitions are the use_door verb, so saves (v3) and replays carry them. Still open: the loader + validation for editor-saved JSON maps, and moving the farm's fixed stations into layout data (the composed WORLD layout already carries its own objects; the DEFAULT farm still uses the module constant).

plan.step: HQ map editor for layout definitions
Object placement becomes layout data (the `objects` key — shipped with the home, T-37)
A second real layout generates and renders (the home, behind a debug door)
CEO ruling: how maps relate in play (doors, transitions, what saves/replays record)
Loader + validation for editor-saved JSON maps
First map transition playable (farm door -> home)

plan_note: Plan is intentionally incomplete pending the maps ruling.
